{{Quote|He saved Coruscant.''"<br />"''At the price of his own life.|Wesell and Jango Fett reflect on the actions of deceased Yarael Poof|<ref name="Star Wars: Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>}}
This '''skirmish''' took place in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], along with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]], attempted to stop [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ashaar Khorda]] and his followers from using the [[Infant of Shaa]] to destroy [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Khorda planned to place the artifact in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Power relay/Legends|power relays]], causing it to explode and release a massive amount of [[The Force/Legends|Force energy]], destroying the planet. However, Fett, Wesell, and Poof were able to defeat and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Khorda and his men, saving Coruscant in the process, though Poof was also killed in the battle.
